oil-and-gas-commission.notes: Section 2 of the Oil and Gas Commission Act took effect on July 31, 1998. The Commission began regulatory operations on October 23. Its reports show the OGC monogram in 2000 and 2008, followed by a green-disc wordmark by July 2009. On February 17, 2023, it continued under the name British Columbia Energy Regulator.

assets.label: Oil and Gas Commission monogram
assets.dateNote: The regulator’s archive dates this publication. The artwork’s adoption date is unverified.
assets.notes: Three joined letters sit between two horizontal rules on a rounded red panel. The 2000/01 report prints the same monogram in black, and the 2008 service plan uses red letters and black rules.
assets.fidelityNote: Eleven painted paths recovered from the report, including the red panel, with the cover rotation preserved. The name and report title below the emblem are cover type.
